notes: Sheet is rotated: north is to the LEFT (east up, west down). Main panel: the hillside subdivision between Brooklyn (top, WOOD STEPS in the roadway) and Columbia Av.; Clarendon, Long and North (all 40') run up-right, East (40') and Columbia (60') run down-right. CARONDOLET, BROOKLYN, CLARENDON, LONG, NORTH and EAST are printed without a suffix; 'Street' added as on the neighbouring sheets. Salutaris Avenue (sheet 327) becomes Brooklyn at Carondolet; both names recorded at that point. The top-left (Carondolet, Clarendon's SW end, Brooklyn west of x~650, Grandview and Minnehaha west of x~650) overlaps sheet 327: 328 = 327 shifted about (-5933, +256). Three unnamed 12'6" alleys (12'6" printed): Clarendon-Long and Long-North run up-right from the SW boundary to East; the third runs along the subdivision's SE line from the boundary to East's SE end. The upper-right region beyond the thick double line (its own COLUMBIA AV. 60' with a 4 in. pipe, references 328/329/330, block 3, match marks A and B) is an inset with no street crossings, so nothing is recorded from it. The long thin lines through the unplatted land (block 3, the triangle between Grandview's end and North's end, and the lines meeting Minnehaha/Ashland) are property lines, not streets. Columbia leaves the right edge (60' printed again there) with no crossing. Points within ~15 px; the Carondolet point depends on one visible line (+/-25 px).
